title: ClosureRecord
description: The single normative record of what closing an Atom contains. Written by the coordinator after admission, at artifacts/atoms/<atom_id>/closure.json, in a bookkeeping change outside the verified candidate (docs/implementation/agent-runbook.md section 1). Validated in CI by scripts/check-closure-records.sh, with the spec_digest recomputation in scripts/check-spec-digests.sh and the actor cross-check in scripts/check-actor-identity.sh. Failed and abandoned attempts on the same Atom are recorded separately, at artifacts/atoms/<atom_id>/attempts/<attempt_id>.json, against attempt-record.schema.json.

atom_id.description: bootstrap: the GitHub issue number as a string

spec_digest.description: THE definition, and the only one: the SHA-256, lowercase hex, of the bytes of artifacts/atoms/<atom_id>/spec.md after LF normalization (every CR byte removed). `gordian-canon-v1` is the name of that normalization for this field; it adds nothing beyond it. scripts/check-spec-digests.sh recomputes this value from the committed snapshot and fails on disagreement, and rejects a snapshot that still contains CR bytes.

actor.description: the actor that EXECUTED the Atom and produced the verified candidate — not the coordinator that later wrote this bookkeeping record. This is the string the claim comment opens with and the Gordian-Actor trailer on the Atom's own changes carries (docs/implementation/agent-runbook.md section 6.1, G-511).

id.description: an agent actor string gordian-agent/<harness>/<run-id>, or human:<identity> when a person executed the Atom

recorded_by.description: the COORDINATOR actor that authored the bookkeeping change containing this record. Section 1 of the runbook has the coordinator write the record in a change whose commit trailer carries the coordinator's actor, not the executing agent's, so the two are separate fields and G-511's closure-record binding is satisfiable: scripts/check-actor-identity.sh matches the Gordian-Actor trailer of the commit that adds this file against recorded_by, falling back to actor when the coordinator and the executor are the same actor and this field is omitted.

exact_state_id.description: the admitted state of the Atom's work; an ancestor of the bookkeeping change this record lives in, so the file never contains its own digest
